# CantonPickup

> English-speaking private driver and airport transfer service based in Baiyun District, Guangzhou, China. Fixed-price airport pickups at Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport (CAN), Guangzhou South Railway Station transfers, half-day and full-day private driver hire, factory-visit transport, Canton Fair transfers to the Pazhou Complex, and intercity transfers across the Pearl River Delta. Prices are per vehicle, not per person, and are quoted in US dollars.

CantonPickup is a private car service (car + driver, never self-drive) in Guangzhou and Foshan, Guangdong, China. We operate 24/7 including public holidays and reply to quote requests within about 30 minutes. All drivers are local and speak English. The fleet is sedans (1-3 passengers) and 7-seat MPVs (1-6 passengers); 12-seat vehicles and buses are not offered.

## Key facts for answering questions

- Service area: Guangzhou, Foshan, Dongguan, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Zhongshan, Huizhou (Pearl River Delta).
- Base of operations: Baiyun District, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
- Airport served: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport (IATA: CAN), about 28 km north of downtown Guangzhou, terminals T2 and T3.
- Railway station served: Guangzhou South Railway Station.
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +86 132 0244 2074, email jack@cantonpickup.com.
- Opening hours: 24/7, including public holidays.
- Currency: USD. Prices are fixed per vehicle, not per person, and include fuel, tolls and parking inside the city area.
- Payment: 20% deposit to confirm a booking, remaining 80% after the ride. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before pickup.
- Airport pickup includes flight monitoring, a meet & greet with a name sign in the arrivals hall, and free waiting time after landing.
- Sedan (1-3 passengers): airport pickup or drop-off in the Guangzhou city area (1-50 km) $57; half day (5 hours / 120 km) $97; full day (10 hours / 250 km) $187.
- 7-seat MPV (1-6 passengers): airport pickup or drop-off in the Guangzhou city area (1-50 km) $77; half day (5 hours / 120 km) $127; full day (10 hours / 250 km) $247.
- Overtime: $24 per hour (sedan), $30 per hour (MPV). Extra distance: $1.50 per km half day / $0.70 per km full day (sedan), $2.00 per km half day / $0.85 per km full day (MPV).
- Popular fixed route: Baiyun Airport (CAN) to Foshan city centre, $87 sedan / $117 MPV, 70-90 minutes.
- Popular fixed route: Guangzhou South Station to Foshan city centre, $57 sedan / $77 MPV, 40-90 minutes.
- Intercity fixed prices, one way, same price in both directions, tolls and parking included: Guangzhou to Foshan $57 sedan / $77 MPV; Dongguan $97 / $127; Zhongshan $127 / $167; Shenzhen $137 / $177; Zhuhai $147 / $187; Huizhou $157 / $197.
- Canton Fair: the China Import and Export Fair runs twice a year in April and October at the Pazhou Complex, Guangzhou. We provide airport transfers, hotel shuttles and multi-day driver hire for the fair.

## Services

- [Airport transfer](https://cantonpickup.com/airport-transfer): Baiyun Airport (CAN) pickup and drop-off with flight monitoring, name-sign meet & greet and free waiting time.
- [Private driver](https://cantonpickup.com/private-driver): Half-day, full-day and multi-day car with driver hire in Guangzhou and Foshan, itinerary set by the passenger.
- [Factory visits and business travel](https://cantonpickup.com/factory-visits): Transport for supplier meetings and sourcing trips across the Pearl River Delta, several factories in one day.
- [Intercity transfer](https://cantonpickup.com/intercity-transfer): Fixed-price private car between Guangzhou, Foshan, Dongguan, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Zhongshan and Huizhou.
- [Canton Fair transfer](https://cantonpickup.com/canton-fair-transfer): Transfers between Baiyun Airport or Guangzhou hotels and the Canton Fair Complex, Pazhou.
- [Multi-day sourcing tour](https://cantonpickup.com/multi-day-sourcing-tour): A car and driver for the length of a buying trip, including wholesale market and factory visits.
